description: Details of Demolition Method Statement and Construction Management Plan part pursuant to condition 14 (part discharge - Phase 1)  of planning permission ref: 250949FUL dated 19/12/2025 for: Site clearance and preparation, including demolition of all existing buildings on site and redevelopment of the site to provide: Construction of four data centre units within three buildings of approximately 67.9m AOD in height (Use Class B8, approximately 158,702sqm GEA), four industrial buildings ranging from approximately 41.3m to 46.2m AOD in height (Use Classes B8, B2 and E(g)(iii), approximately 23,389 GEA), central pavilion building of approximately 35m AOD in height (Use Class E(b), approximately 223 GEA), two substations (38.05m AOD in height), associated plant, enclosures and necessary physical security systems, internal roads, servicing, circulation, car and cycle parking and hard and soft landscaping works.
